义项: 名词 接替某人职位或地位的人（their successors 他们的后人）
[辨析] 与 heir（血亲继承人）不同，successor 更强调职位、事业或时代的接续

例句.英文: Few of the personages of past times (except such as have gained renown in fireside legends as well as in written history) are anything but mere names to their successors.
例句.中文: 过去时代的众多人物（除了那些在民间传说与书面历史中同样享有盛名者）对后人而言，大多只是空洞的名字。

义项: 名词 需要非凡技能或勇气才能完成的事（acrobatic feats 特技动作）
[辨析] 与 achievement 近义，但 feat 更强调动作的惊险、技巧性

例句.英文: As one of aviation’s earliest female stunt performers, Gladys Ingle developed a versatile repertoire of acrobatic feats.
例句.中文: 作为航空界最早的女性特技表演者之一，格拉迪斯·英格尔练就了一套多样的空中特技。

例句.英文: He achieved many incredible martial arts feats—some confirmed and some rumored..
例句.中文: 他创下许多惊人的武术功绩——有些确有其事，有些只是传闻。

义项: 名词 有组织的远行以探索或研究（led the expedition 率领考察队）
名词 (引申义) （短途的）出行、远足

例句.英文: For example, people will always remember that Enid Gordon-Gallien led the expedition that first mapped the area around Kalambo Falls between Zambia and Tanzania.
例句.中文: 例如，人们会永远记得，是伊妮德·戈登-加利恩率领考察队首次绘制了赞比亚与坦桑尼亚之间卡兰博瀑布周边地区的地图。

例句.英文: NASA mission Expedition 14 took place from September 18, 2006, to April 21, 2007.
例句.中文: 美国国家航空航天局第 14 远征队任务的时间为 2006 年 9 月 18 日至 2007 年 4 月 21 日。

义项: 名词 基于不完整信息的推想（characterized by speculation 以思辨为特征）
名词 (引申义) 投机（speculation in property 房地产投机）

例句.英文: At its core, the movement is characterized by speculation, not just about distant futures or other planets but also about alternate versions of our shared past.
例句.中文: 这场运动的核心特征便是思辨——不仅思辨遥远的未来与别的星球，也思辨我们共同过去的其他版本。

例句.英文: Well-realized and coherent alternative-history stories can thus complement historians’ speculations about the past.
例句.中文: 写得丰满而连贯的架空历史小说，由此能够补充历史学家对过去的种种推测。

义项: 形容词 缺乏精细加工或品味的（crude comedies 粗俗喜剧）
形容词 未加工的、原状的（crude oil 原油）

例句.英文: In economics, sugar is considered a soft commodity, while copper and crude oil are considered hard commodities.
例句.中文: 其中包括粗俗喜剧和恶作剧之类的娱乐形式。

例句.英文: Historian Vicki Valosik claims, “In providing instructions for these aquatic ‘refinements,’ Digby hoped to revive swimming—a once revered skill that had all but died out during Europe’s Dark Ages—and elevate it from a crude, mechanical function of the hands and feet to an artful science.”
例句.中文: 历史学家 Vicki Valosik 声称：「通过为这些水上『精进之术』提供指导，迪格比希望复兴游泳——这项一度备受尊崇、却几乎绝迹于欧洲黑暗年代的技艺——并把它从手脚的粗笨机械功能提升为一门精妙科学。」

义项: 形容词 对比或差异极为明显（stark contrasts 鲜明对比）
形容词 (引申义) 荒凉的、赤裸的（a stark landscape 荒凉的景色）

例句.英文: The prints in Images of Autonomous Matter, part of a traveling exhibition of innovative Japanese art from the 1960s and 1970s, exemplify the interest in creating minimalist images of stark materials, such as steel, that first emerged among Japanese printmakers in the mid-to-late twentieth century.
例句.中文: 《自主物质的影像》（Images of Autonomous Matter）中的版画——出自一个巡展、展出 20 世纪六七十年代日本先锋艺术——体现了对以冷硬材料（如钢）营造极简图像的兴趣；这种兴趣于 20 世纪中后期最早出现在日本版画家中。

义项: 形容词 仅此而无其他成分（through sheer determination 仅凭决心）
形容词 (引申义) 陡峭的；极薄的（sheer cliffs 陡峭的悬崖）

例句.英文: Lin-Manuel Miranda’s 2015 hip-hop musical Hamilton depicts historical political figure Alexander Hamilton as a self-made man who, through sheer determination, transcends his humble origins to become a key participant in the founding of the United States.
例句.中文: 林-曼努尔·米兰达 2015 年的嘻哈音乐剧《汉密尔顿》把历史政治人物亚历山大·汉密尔顿塑造成白手起家者——他仅凭决心便超越卑微出身，成为美国建国的重要参与者。

例句.英文: Williams and the television miniseries Sheer Perfection, persisted on the site for many years before they were finally recognized as falsehoods and deleted.
例句.中文: ……Williams 以及电视迷你剧《Sheer Perfection》的词条在网站上存续多年，才最终被识破为虚构并删除。

义项: 动词 为某事物留出空间或作出调整（accommodate making a unique product 适应每次生产独特产品）
动词 (引申义) 迁就、通融（accommodate a request 通融一项请求）

例句.英文: Still, it can be difficult for companies to offer customization while keeping costs low, as the standard methods of mass production may not be able to accommodate making a unique product each time.
例句.中文: 不过，企业要在压低成本的同时提供定制并不容易，因为大规模生产的标准方法未必能适应每次生产一件独一无二的产品。

义项: 名词 成体系的政治或社会信念（ideological works 意识形态色彩鲜明的作品）
[词族] ideological 意识形态的；ideologue 意识形态鼓吹者

例句.英文: Capital and Ideology has different aims than Piketty's earlier books.
例句.中文: 《资本与意识形态》与皮凯蒂此前的著作旨趣不同。

义项: 名词 带有感情色彩的态度或心境（capture this sentiment 捕捉这种情绪）
名词 (引申义) （群体的）意见、观点（public sentiment 公众意见）

例句.英文: As with many Highwaymen paintings, the appeal of Yellow Day derived from its ability to capture this sentiment.
例句.中文: 与许多「公路人」画派的画作一样，《黄日》的感染力来自它捕捉这种情绪的能力。

义项: 动词 为完善而追加（supplement the message with an emoji 用表情符号补充文字信息）
名词 /ˈsʌplɪmənt/ 补充物、增刊；nutritional supplement 营养补充剂

例句.英文: Having found that object emojis generally have a negative effect when used in social media marketing, Anika Desai and team studied reactions to three versions of a bakery’s message about tea: one with a teacup emoji after the text (supplement), one with the emoji standing in for the word “tea” (substitute), and one with no emoji (control).
例句.中文: 在发现物体类表情符号用于社交媒体营销通常产生负面效果之后，Anika Desai 及其团队研究了人们对一家面包店茶饮信息的三种版本的反应：一种在文字后加茶杯表情（补充型）。

例句.英文: It had twelve months divided into tree weeks of ten days each, followed by five supplemental days..
例句.中文: 它把十二个月分为每月三个十日周，其后另加五个补充日。

义项: 名词 法庭上对事实的正式认定（reach a verdict 作出裁决）
名词 (引申义) （经过思考后的）判断、评价（the verdict of the public 公众的评判）

例句.英文: … resigned or not to the verdict of the public …
例句.中文: 无论是否甘于接受公众的评判。

义项: 名词 三面临水、一面连陆的陆地（the Malay Peninsula 马来半岛）
[词族] insular 岛屿的；peninsular 半岛的

例句.英文: A team of scientists led by Artin Arshamian evaluated this view by testing how people from ten different places—including the Semelai people from a small community in the Malay Peninsula and the Chachi people from a small community in Ecuador—ranked ten odors from most pleasant to least pleasant.
例句.中文: 由 Artin Arshamian 带领的团队通过测试十个不同地区的人如何排序来评估这一观点，其中包括来自马来半岛一个小社群的塞迈人和来自厄瓜多尔一个小社群的查奇人。

例句.英文: A team led by Octavio Aburto-Oropeza surveyed the biomass density and species composition of two isolated reefs: Alacranes, a protected (fishing prohibited) reef 135 kilometers from the Yucatan Peninsula, and Bajos del Norte, an unprotected reef 25 kilometers further out to sea.
例句.中文: 由 Octavio Aburto-Oropeza 领队的团队考察了两处孤立珊瑚礁的生物量密度与物种构成：一是距尤卡坦半岛 135 公里、禁止捕鱼的保护区阿尔克兰斯礁，二是再往外海 25 公里、不受保护的巴霍斯德尔诺特礁。

义项: 名词 进门处的横木，转指进入的界线（cross the threshold 跨过门槛）
名词 (引申义) 临界值、阈值（a required threshold 规定的最低标准）

例句.英文: Never, however, was I so aware of entering a new stage as I was that afternoon in October when I finally dared to cross the threshold and my steps sounded hollowly in the unfurnished apartment.
例句.中文: 然而，我从未像那年十月的那天下午那样清晰地意识到自己正踏入一个新阶段——我终于敢跨过那道门槛，脚步声在空荡的公寓里发出空洞的回响。

例句.英文: Traveling waves break when wave steepness (height-to-length ratio) passes a critical threshold; breaking thus constrains wave height.
例句.中文: 行进波在陡度（高长比）超过临界阈值时破碎；因此破碎限制了波高。

义项: 形容词 不主动行动或抵抗的（in a passive sort of way 以一种被动的方式）
[辨析] 与 active 相对；语法上指被动语态（passive voice）

例句.英文: When Thornton’s partners, Hans and Pete, arrived on the long-expected raft, Buck refused to notice them till he learned they were close to Thornton; after that he tolerated them in a passive sort of way, accepting favors from them as though he favored them by accepting.
例句.中文: 当桑顿的伙伴汉斯和皮特乘着期盼已久的木筏到达时，巴克起初不肯理会他们，直到发现他们与桑顿亲近，之后才以一种被动的方式容忍他们，接受他们的好意仿佛那是施舍。

例句.英文: Their findings revealed that the majority of the turtles passively drifted with ocean currents throughout the region.
例句.中文: 他们的发现显示：多数海龟在该海域全程随洋流被动漂流。

义项: 形容词 处于静止状态（the materials are static 材料处于静止状态）
形容词 (引申义) 静态的、缺乏变化的（a static economy 停滞的经济）；名词「静电干扰」

例句.英文: Friction, the force that resists the movement of two materials in contact with each other, exists even when the materials are static (not moving).
例句.中文: 摩擦力是阻止两个接触物体相对运动的力，即使物体处于静止状态时也存在。

义项: 名词 对某议题所持的公开态度（take a stance 表明立场）
名词 站姿（a relaxed stance 放松的站姿）

例句.英文: Thus, Enke et al. suggest that although the behavior of high-income earners who advocate for higher taxes may seem counterintuitive, such people likely do so because they feel enabled by their economic security to take a stance they think is morally correct.
例句.中文: 这类人之所以如此，很可能是觉得自己有经济保障作为支撑，因而敢于采取自认为道德上正确的立场。

例句.英文: An ancient statue from the Huasteca region of Mexico represents a subject not seen before in artifacts from the area: a woman in an assertive stance wearing items used in a ceremonial ballgame.

义项: 形容词 约公元 5 至 15 世纪的欧洲（medieval England 中世纪的英格兰）
[辨析] 也拼作 mediaeval；注意与 middle-aged（中年的）无关

例句.英文: Lestek appears in the Gesta principum Polonorum, a chronicle of medieval Polishhistory written between 1112 and 1118.
例句.中文: Lestek 见载于《波兰诸王公编年史》（Gesta principum Polonorum）——一部写于 1112 至 1118 年间的中世纪波兰史编年史。

例句.英文: Dating to around 1500, the Unicorn Tapestries are seven large tapestries depicting a unicorn hunt that hang in The Cloisters, a museum of medieval art in New York City.
例句.中文: 《独角兽挂毯》织于约 1500 年，共七幅巨作，描绘一场独角兽狩猎，悬挂于纽约的中世纪艺术博物馆「修道院分馆」。

义项: 名词 文章或论证所要确立的核心命题（the central thesis 中心论点）
名词 (引申义) 学位论文（a doctoral thesis 博士论文）

例句.英文: Even when sections do not explicitly support the central thesis, they link to each other in intriguing ways.
例句.中文: 即便某些段落并未明确支持中心论点，它们之间仍相互呼应。

义项: 名词 在某一领域长期积累的专精能力（acquired expertise 习得的专业知识）
[辨析] 与 skill 相比更强调系统化、领域性的知识；与 expert 同源

例句.英文: By contrast, doing philosophy within or beyond the academy demands the creative, self-directed application of acquired expertise to enduring questions about the nature of existence and knowledge.
例句.中文: 相比之下，在学院之内或之外从事哲学，都要求把习得的专业知识创造性地、自主地运用于关于存在与知识之本质的恒久问题。

例句.英文: Studies have shown that consumers view exact prices as reflecting merchant expertise and careful calculation, so why aren’t they more common?
例句.中文: 研究表明，消费者把精确价格视为商家专业与审慎计算的体现，那为何此类定价并不更常见？

义项: 形容词 细节丰富、制作考究的（elaborate baskets 精巧的篮子）
动词 /ɪˈlæbəreɪt/ 详细阐述（elaborate on a point 详述某点）

例句.英文: Pomo artist Susan Billy creates elaborate baskets.
例句.中文: 波莫族艺术家苏珊·比利制作精巧繁复的篮子。

例句.英文: It contained elaborate multistory buildings primarily made of adobe and stone..
例句.中文: 它拥有以土坯和石材为主的多层精巧建筑。

义项: 名词 某一活动或知识的界域（the realm of cinema 电影领域）
名词 (引申义) 王国、疆域（the realm 王国）

例句.英文: Although Grant Tavinor concludes that computer games are art by virtue of their forming a subcategory of fiction, and Berys Gaut similarly places them within the realm of cinema, neither approach adequately captures a central aspect of playing these games: when the player no longer attends to the narrative and is instead simply absorbed in the instrumentalities of gameplay.
例句.中文: 尽管 Grant Tavinor 认为电子游戏因构成虚构的一个子类而属于艺术，Berys Gaut 也同样把它们归入电影的领域，但这两种路径都未能充分把握游玩这些游戏的一个核心方面。

例句.英文: Posada: “My art is a journey through the invisible realm—a space where intuition, memories, visions, and dreams are free to take visual form.”
例句.中文: 波萨达：「我的艺术是一场穿越无形之境的旅程——在那里，直觉、记忆、幻象与梦，都可以自由地获得视觉形态。」

义项: 名词 a testament to 对…的有力证明
名词 遗嘱；《圣经》中的「约书」

例句.英文: The show is therefore a testament to the Lindy Hop’s enduring influence on American culture.
例句.中文: 因此，这场演出是林迪舞对美国文化持久影响力的明证。

例句.英文: That such systems get successfully set up is a testament to the installers’ expertise.

义项: 名词 君主在位的年代（during his reign 在他统治期间）
[辨析] 与 rein（缰绳）同音；reign 作动词亦指「盛行、占主导」

例句.英文: Trade with other societies was vital to the Byzantine Empire, which reigned in the Mediterranean from around 330 CE to 1453 CE.
例句.中文: 与其他社会的贸易对拜占庭帝国至关重要——公元约 330 年至 1453 年，它称雄地中海。

例句.英文: Though his reign ended roughly twenty years before Siam became known by its modern name of Thailand, King Chulalongkorn is often credited with ushering the nation into modernity.
例句.中文: 尽管朱拉隆功国王的统治结束于暹罗改称泰国之前约二十年，人们仍常把引领这个国家迈入现代的功绩归于他。

义项: 名词 对生活或未来的总体态度（positive outlook 积极心态）
名词 (引申义) 前景、展望（the economic outlook 经济前景）

例句.英文: In a large‑scale analysis, Lauren Hoult and colleagues determined that while different techniques produce varying outcomes, they all tend to have a more consistent effect on well‑being and positive outlook than on physical health and stress.
例句.中文: 在一项大规模分析中，Lauren Hoult 及其同事确定：尽管不同技术产生的结果各异，但它们对幸福感和积极心态的影响，普遍比对身体健康和压力的影响更为一致。

例句.英文: The researchers used these ratings to rank the services for each group, with a conclusion that both stakeholders and general public regard the improvement of attitude and outlooks as important benefit of urban agriculture.
例句.中文: 研究者用这些评分给各组的服务排序，结论是：利益相关方与普通公众都把「改善态度与观念」视为城市农业的重要收益。

义项: 形容词 关乎行为对错准则的（an ethical system 一套伦理体系）
[辨析] 与 moral 近义；ethics 伦理学、职业道德

例句.英文: Purcell reveals that these works posit an ethical system in which an individual's actions are judged in light of how well they accord with the individual's role in society and how well they contribute to the community.
例句.中文: 珀塞尔指出，这些作品提出了一套伦理体系：判断个人行为时，要看它与其社会角色的契合程度，以及它对共同体的贡献程度。

义项: 名词 包裹其他物质的基底材料（the surrounding matrix 周围的基质）
名词 (引申义) 矩阵、框架（a matrix of options 选项矩阵）

例句.英文: Since chemically analyzing bulk samples can occlude contextual details, Slotznick et al. also employed high-resolution microscopy, which revealed volcanic debris—a known Mo host—around 2.5 Ga and microfractures in the surrounding matrix.
例句.中文: 由于对 bulk 样品做化学分析会遮蔽语境细节，Slotznick 等人还采用了高分辨率显微技术，结果显示约 25 亿年前存在火山碎屑（已知的钼来源），以及周围基质中的微裂隙。

例句.英文: The minerals in the rock sample record three growth stages: crystal core zones formed first, then rim zones, and finally the surrounding matrix.
例句.中文: 岩石样本中的矿物记录了三个生长阶段：先形成晶体核部，继之是边缘带，最后是周围基质。

义项: 名词 值得肯定之处（literary merit 文学价值）
动词 值得、应得（merit attention 值得关注）

例句.英文: Forster and other prominent English-language novelists and found that there is a positive correlation between low -ly adverb frequency and novels’ perceived literary merit.
例句.中文: 福斯特等知名英语小说家，并发现小说中 -ly 副词的使用频率越低，其被认为的文学价值越高，二者呈正相关。

例句.英文: Acclaimed author Sam Kean, who uses the form of nonfiction narrative to explore scientific discoveries, is interested in the collection less for its aesthetic merit than for its focus on “the false starts.and mistakes that beset real scientific research every day.” Kean argues that all too often, scientists omit this “human stuff” from written accounts of their research and thus ultimately “fail to explain how science really gets done.”
例句.中文: 以非虚构叙事探讨科学发现的知名作家 Sam Kean，看中这批藏品与其说因其美学价值，不如说因其聚焦「真实科研每天都遭遇的失败起点与失误」。Kean 认为，科学家在书面研究叙述中往往略去这些「人的成分」，因而终究「没能解释科学究竟是如何做成的」。

义项: 名词 没有物质的 space（travel through a vacuum 在真空中传播）
名词 (引申义) 空白、真空状态（a power vacuum 权力真空）

例句.英文: It represents the distance that light travels through a vacuum in one Earth year—approximately 5.88 trillion miles or 9.46 trillion kilometers.
例句.中文: 它表示光在真空中一年所走的距离——约 5.88 万亿英里，即 9.46 万亿公里。

例句.英文: To investigate how market share affects consumers' likelihood of purchasing brand extensions, Alicia Grasby et al. identified 30 extended brand pairs (e.g., the same brand of vacuum cleaner and microwave) in household purchasing data; for each pair, Grasby et al. calculated the branded products' market share and calculated the increase in probability of a brand in one category being purchased if the same brand was purchased in the other category.
例句.中文: 为考察市场份额如何影响消费者购买品牌延伸产品的可能性，Alicia Grasby 等人在家庭购买数据中识别出 30 个延伸品牌对（如同一品牌的吸尘器与微波炉）；对每一对，Grasby 等计算了品牌产品的市场份额，并计算「若在某品类购买了某品牌，在另一品类购买该品牌的概率增量」。

义项: 名词 群体内广泛一致的看法（scientific consensus 科学界的共识）
[辨析] 与 consent（同意）不同，consensus 强调意见的汇聚而非许可

例句.英文: Scientific consensus held that early dogs had large body mass and that a genetic driver of smaller size in some breeds (e.g., bulldogs) developed only within the last 20,000 years as a result of selective breeding for characteristics favored by humans.
例句.中文: 科学界此前的共识是：早期犬类体型较大，而某些品种（如斗牛犬）体型变小的基因驱动因素，是近两万年内人类按偏好进行选择育种的结果。

例句.英文: If Venusian PH₃ does exist, it would indicate insufficiencies in the current consensus on Venus’s chemistry.
例句.中文: 如果金星上的磷化氢确实存在，将表明当前关于金星化学的共识存在不足。

义项: 形容词 与货币制度相关的（a common unit of monetary exchange 共同的货币交换单位）
[辨析] monetary policy 货币政策；与 fiscal（财政的）区分

例句.英文: In a commodity money economy, specific goods act as a common unit of monetary exchange that can be used to buy and sell other goods.
例句.中文: 在商品货币经济中，特定商品充当共同的货币交换单位，可用来买卖其他商品。

例句.英文: Champ and Freeman: when “individuals might come to accept one particular good in exchange for others even if they do not wish to consume that good…barter economies essentially become monetary economies.”
例句.中文: Champ 与 Freeman 指出：当「个人可能愿意接受某件特定物品来交换其他物品，即便自己并不想消费它……以物易物经济实际上就变成了货币经济」。

义项: 名词 整齐排列的一组事物（a balanced array of different-sized pieces 一组均衡排布的、大小不一的石块）
名词 (引申义) 阵列、数组；动词「排列、部署」

例句.英文: In this work, Long set up a large circle made out of a balanced array of different‑sized pieces of slate.
例句.中文: 在这件作品中，朗用一组均衡排布的、大小不一的石板围成一个大圆圈。

例句.英文: Farmer has shown that expanding the array of primary sources to encompass more types of print material‑including political cartoons, advertisements, and artwork‑leads to a much better understanding of the movement and the crucial and diverse roles that Black women played in shaping it.
例句.中文: Farmer 已证明：把一手来源扩展到更多种类的印刷品——政治漫画、广告与美术作品——能让我们远为透彻地理解这场运动，以及黑人女性在塑造它时扮演的关键而多元的角色。

义项: 形容词 由不同来源组合而成的（hybrid systems 混合系统）
名词 杂交品种；混合动力车（a hybrid car）

例句.英文: As research continues, scientists hope to make advancements in hybrid systems combining multiple food preservation technologies, which would be advantageous over using microwave heating alone, given that it often heats food unevenly.
例句.中文: 随着研究推进，科学家希望在结合多种食品保鲜技术的混合系统上取得进展——相比单用微波加热更有优势，因为后者常使食物受热不均。

例句.英文: He uses the term “flauna” to describe the plant-animal hybrids that he depicts in his surreal paintings. .
例句.中文: 他用「flauna」一词来称呼其超现实画作中的动植物杂交体。

义项: 形容词 （商标）因被普遍使用而失去专有性（a generic term 通用名称）
形容词 (引申义) 缺乏特色的、笼统的（a generic response 笼统的回应）

例句.英文: If "Frisbee" were judged to have become a generic term, as "aspirin" was, other companies would be free to use it to promote similar products, making it harder for Wham-O to stand out from competitors.
例句.中文: 如果「Frisbee」被判定已成为像「aspirin」那样的通用名称，其他公司便可自由用它来推销同类产品，Wham-O 也就更难在竞争中凸显自己。

例句.英文: Participants in several of the experiments regarded the same products in the same (generic) retail settings as significantly more valuable when the product-to-space ratio was low than when it was high.
例句.中文: 在数项实验中，参与者对同一（无品牌的）零售环境中的相同产品的估值，在产品间距比低时显著高于间距比高时。

义项: 形容词 与知觉、记忆、推理等心智过程相关的（cognitive abilities 认知能力）
[词族] cognition 认知；cognitive science 认知科学

例句.英文: Graham and Catherine Hobaiter hypothesized that humans may be able to interpret great ape gestures, either through an evolutionary inheritance or as part of more general human cognitive abilities.
例句.中文: 格雷厄姆与凯瑟琳·霍拜特提出假设：人类或许能解读大型类人猿的手势，这或者源于演化上的继承，或者属于人类更一般的认知能力的一部分。

例句.英文: Though one prominent hypothesis posits that sophisticated cognitive adaptations are primarily driven by the demands of various behaviors within established social groups (e.g., cooperative response to predation), interactions with same-species outsiders arguably contribute comparably by favoring nuanced analysis (e.g., evaluation of relative physical status).
例句.中文: 尽管一个著名假说认为复杂的认知适应主要由既有社会群体内各类行为的需求驱动（如协作应对捕食），与同种外来者的互动或许同样重要——它催生细腻的分析（如评估相对体格）。

义项: 名词 使开口合拢（the closure of stomata 气孔的闭合）
名词 (引申义) （心理上的）了结、closure 感；停业、封院

例句.英文: It appears that feeding triggers the closure of stomata—tiny openings that allow carbon dioxide to enter the leaf—thereby limiting plants’ ability to fix carbon (capture and convert it to carbohydrates during photosynthesis).
例句.中文: 看来，进食会触发气孔闭合——气孔是让二氧化碳进入叶片的微小开口——从而限制植物固定碳（在光合作用中捕获并转化为碳水化合物）的能力。

例句.英文: The student, however, claims that ultimately audiences of the time preferred resolution and closure over ongoing tension.
例句.中文: 然而该学生主张：当年的观众终究更偏爱化解与收束，而非持续紧绷。

义项: 名词 实验中可变化或被控制的因素（control important variables 控制重要变量）
形容词 多变的、不稳定的（variable weather 多变的天气）

例句.英文: Lab studies are useful because they make it easy to control important variables, but white—throated sparrows' surroundings can significantly affect their hormone levels.
例句.中文: 实验室研究之所以有用，是因为它们便于控制重要变量；但白喉带鹀的所处环境会显著影响其激素水平。

例句.英文: While there are several possible reasons for this, one is that practitioners may overlook confounding variables that account for the results they attribute to the interventions in question.
例句.中文: 原因可能有好几种，其一是从业者可能忽略了能解释结果的混杂变量，却把结果归因于所考察的干预。

义项: 形容词 位置紧挨着的（two adjacent sensors 两个相邻的传感器）
[辨析] 与 adjoining 近义；adjacent to 与…相邻

例句.英文: Liao conducted tests to find where the difference in pressure is greatest between two adjacent sensors because, according to the researchers, as these pressure differences increase, so does the amount of information available to the fish.
例句.中文: 廖氏做了测试，以找出两个相邻传感器之间压力差最大的位置，因为据研究者所言，压力差越大，鱼可获取的信息量就越大。

例句.英文: Curiously, the same barriers are associated with diversification within language families adjacent to isolates, such that the incidence of isolates like Natchez functions as an index of overall linguistic diversity in a region.
例句.中文: 奇怪的是，同样的壁垒也与孤立语言毗邻语族内部的分化相关，以至于 Natchez 这类孤立语的出现率可作为一地区整体语言多样性的指数。

义项: 名词 作为一个整体被看待的存在（noncharitable entities 非慈善实体）
[辨析] 法律、商业语境常指「法人、机构」；与 being 相比更强调独立性与整体性

例句.英文: The Demak Sultanate, a Muslim sea power based on the island of Java that reached its height around 1500 CE, is considered a thalassocracy—a geopolitical entity whose hegemony resulted from control of the sea rather than of land.
例句.中文: 德马克苏丹国是以爪哇岛为基地的穆斯林海上强权，约在公元 1500 年前后达到鼎盛，被视为一个「海上霸权」（thalassocracy）——一种凭控制海洋而非陆地取得霸权的地缘政治实体。

例句.英文: Bohr proposed that subatomic entities like electrons had only probable realities until they were observed..
例句.中文: 玻尔提出：像电子这样的亚原子实体在被观测之前，只有概率性的实在。

义项: 名词 致力于某一目标或活动（a worthwhile pursuit 值得从事的追求）
名词 (引申义) 追赶、追捕（in pursuit of 追捕…）；消遣、爱好

例句.英文: But it's not clear that this is a worthwhile pursuit in any case—as Jin Ha Lee and Anh Thu Nguyen argue in their study of the South Korean band BTS, relationships between pieces of music may be best understood with concepts other than genre. Text 2Tango is a genre of music originally from Argentina and Uruguay that shares some harmonic and rhythmic similarities with the pagode genre.
例句.中文: 但无论如何，这是否是一项值得从事的追求，尚不清楚——正如 Jin Ha Lee 与 Anh Thu Nguyen 在对韩国组合 BTS 的研究中所主张的，音乐作品之间的关系或许用「类型」之外的概念来理解更为恰当。

例句.英文: This pose symbolizes their support for each other in the pursuit of equality.
例句.中文: 这一姿势象征着她们在追求平等的路上彼此扶持。

义项: 名词 采集与发布新闻的行业（Black journalism 黑人新闻业）
[词族] journalist 记者；journalistic 新闻业的

例句.英文: Wells-Barnett’s accomplishment is just one example of the rich history of Black journalism in the United States.
例句.中文: 韦尔斯-巴尼特的成就只是美国黑人新闻业丰厚历史中的一个例子。

例句.英文: Thus, it is unsurprising that this city became such a rich site for Spanish-language journalism.
例句.中文: 因此毫不意外，这座城市成为西语新闻业如此丰饶的据点。

义项: 形容词 成直线排列的（linear chains of glucose 线性的葡萄糖链）
形容词 (引申义) 线性的（指按顺序推进、非并行）（linear narrative 线性叙事）

例句.英文: Typically, synthetic leather is petroleum based, but materials scientists searching for an ecologically sustainable alternative have used various bacteria that secrete linear chains of glucose, forming a dense mesh of cellulose called a pellicle, which is leatherlike except in color.
例句.中文: 合成革通常以石油为原料，但寻找生态可持续替代品的材料科学家已利用多种细菌分泌线性的葡萄糖链，形成被称为「菌膜」的致密纤维素网状结构。

例句.英文: Previous research has found evidence of Spanish speakers referring to the front/back axis to describe events in time, and many researchers believe that this tendency to make temporal distinctions along imagined linear axes is universal.
例句.中文: 此前研究发现，西语使用者借助前/后轴来描述时间事件；许多研究者相信这种沿想象中的线性轴作时间区分的倾向是普世的。

义项: 形容词 感知力强的（keen eyesight 敏锐的视力）
形容词 (引申义) 热衷的（be keen on 热衷于）；锋利的（a keen edge 利刃）

例句.英文: Being slow protects them from predators with keen eyesight.
例句.中文: 行动迟缓反而使它们免于被视力敏锐的捕食者发现。

义项: 名词 安全或安宁的处所（tax havens 避税天堂）
[辨析] 与 harbour 近义，但 haven 更强调「逃离危险/压力的安身之处」

例句.英文: Economist Gabriel Zucman finds that 8% of worldwide household wealth is held in tax havens (territories such as Singapore with low tax rates for investors who reside outside those territories).
例句.中文: 经济学家 Gabriel Zucman 发现，全球家庭财富中有 8% 存放于避税地——即对非居民投资者征收低税率地区，如新加坡。

例句.英文: I’m as hungry as the winter, I’m ill, I’m shaken… and where haven’t I been—fate has tossed me everywhere!

义项: 名词 对自身与外界的主观觉知（my own consciousness 我自己的意识）
名词 (引申义) （群体的）意识、觉悟（class consciousness 阶级意识）

例句.英文: The wood I walk in on this mild April day, with the young yellow-brown foliage of the beeches between me and the blue sky, the white anemones and the blue violets and the ground ivy at my feet, what grove of tropic palms, what strange ferns or splendid broad-petalled blossoms, could ever thrill such deep and delicate fibres within me as this home scene?​​​​​​​ My feelings seem to be those of our ancient earth in the daily ecstasy of its sun-kissed life; my own consciousness seems to stream through each blade of grass, each sucking root, to rise with the sap through the trees, to break out with joyous thrills in the waving fields of wheat, in the rustling palm leaves.
例句.中文: 我自己的意识仿佛流过每一片草叶。

例句.英文: A contingent on B immaterial to C uncharacteristic of D determinative of Can artificial intelligence (AI) truly capture human consciousness?

义项: 名词 远离尘嚣的僻静居所（his solitary retreat 他独居的静修之所）
动词 撤退、退却（retreat from 从…撤退）

例句.英文: If instead the giant short-faced bear died out before humans could have altered its habitat, that suggests that its extinction was the result of some other factor, such as change in sea levels as a result of glaciers retreating.
例句.中文: 在海边那处独居的静修之所，海面随波起伏，从敞开的窗子望出去，一直延伸到与天际相接；弗洛伦蒂诺神父正以弹奏簧风琴来排遣单调，琴声哀婉。

义项: 名词 地位、资历相当者（peer review 同行评审）
动词 凝视、端详（peer at 仔细看）

例句.英文: Carson published the first peer-reviewed rap album about his experiences with Black masculinity called "I used to love to dream. " Typically in peer review, experts evaluate scholarly articles prior to publication.
例句.中文: 卡森发布了首张经同行评审的说唱专辑，讲述他关于黑人男性气质的经历。

例句.英文: Economists have demonstrated that herding—in which individuals converge on the same action by imitating the economic decisions of one or more peers―occurs among investors.
例句.中文: 经济学家已经证明：羊群效应——个体通过模仿一个或多个同侪的经济决策而趋同于同一行动——确实发生在投资者之中。

义项: 名词 物价总水平持续上涨（an inflation rate of 4.30% 4.30% 的通胀率）
名词 (引申义) 膨胀、充气（the inflation of a balloon 气球充气）

例句.英文: Mongolia, which, according to international indices, has relatively strong democratic institutions and low intranational income inequality, experienced an inflation rate of 4.30% in 2017, whereas Cameroon, which shows the opposite pattern on such indices, had an inflation rate of only 0.64% that year.
例句.中文: 据国际指数显示，蒙古拥有相对稳健的民主制度，国内收入不平等程度较低，2017 年通胀率为 4.30%；而喀麦隆在这些指标上呈相反态势。

例句.英文: In 2017, Belgium, which has strong democratic institutions, experienced an inflation rate of 2.12%, much higher than the 0.74% rate seen in Equatorial Guinea, which has relatively weak democratic institutions.
例句.中文: 2017 年，民主制度健全的比利时通胀率为 2.12%，远高于民主制度相对薄弱的赤道几内亚的 0.74%。

义项: 形容词 脱离具体形象的（Abstract Expressionism 抽象表现主义）
名词 /ˈæbstrækt/ 摘要；动词 /əbˈstrækt/ 提取、抽象化

例句.英文: Cannon, typically aligned their compositional strategies with Abstract Expressionism—a school of painting dominated by European American artists—instead of with traditionally nonrepresentational forms of Indigenous art.
例句.中文: 坎农等人的创作策略与抽象表现主义——一个由欧裔美国艺术家主导的画派——相一致，而非与土著艺术中传统的非具象形式相一致。

例句.英文: D respondents have little concern about the collection and use of personal data in the abstract but are uncomfortable with their own data being collected and used.

义项: 名词 企业持有的货物（inventory holding costs 库存持有成本）
名词 (引申义) 清单、盘点（take inventory 盘点）

例句.英文: Comprising 7,200 simulated production planning instances, each involving seventy-two products across twelve time periods, the data set systematically varies three critical factors: product demand patterns (six scenarios, including fluctuating demand), production capacity utilization rates (high and low), and the balance between set-up and inventory holding costs (three scenarios).
例句.中文: 该数据集包含 7,200 个模拟生产计划实例，每个实例涉及七十二种产品、十二个时间段，并系统性地变化三个关键因素：产品需求模式、产能利用率，以及生产准备成本与库存持有成本之间的平衡。

例句.英文: The algorithms help identify efficient production schedules by processing those quantifiable inputs (e.g., inventory levels and resource constraints) without exhaustively testing all possible scenarios.
例句.中文: 这些算法通过处理可量化的输入（如库存水平与资源约束）来找出高效的生产排程，而无需穷举所有可能的方案。
